resources.string: To cast, Maktaba needs to see devices on your Wi-Fi. You\'ll be asked next.
This home is older, so the TV shows Google\'s player.
No TV found. The TV must be on the same Wi-Fi network as this phone. On a TV that has Maktaba\'s own app, open it there.
This video can\'t be cast from your account.
Casting needs a sign-in on the home itself, not through Maktaba Cloud.
The TV didn\'t start the video. Try again.
The TV can\'t reach your home. Check that it\'s on the same network, or use the home\'s secure address.
The TV can\'t play this video\'s format.
The cast has ended. Cast again to keep watching on the TV.
The TV needs a newer home. Update Maktaba on the home, then cast again.
